remarks: Experience the perfect blend of comfort and elegance in this stunning home, set on an expansive 1-acre lot in New Canaan, CT. Thoughtfully designed with exceptional craftsmanship, this home seamlessly combines modern conveniences with timeless charm. Inside, an inviting layout features gleaming hardwood floors that flow throughout. The well-appointed kitchen offers ample counter space, making it a great space for cooking and entertaining. The family room stands out with its high ceilings and exposed wood beams, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The bedrooms are designed as private sanctuaries, with the Primary suite offering a spa-like en-suite bath and walk-in closets. For car enthusiasts or those seeking extra storage, the oversized four-car garage is a standout feature, offering ample space for vehicles, recreational gear, and more. This home has been meticulously maintained and features a brand-new roof, ensuring peace of mind for years to come. Situated at the end of a beautiful cul-de-sac, 38 Tommys Lane offers both privacy and convenience. Located within walking distance to award-winning Saxe Middle School, South Elementary, and New Canaan High School, this home is also less than a five-minute drive to downtown New Canaan. With natural gas, public water, and central air, this property provides both comfort and efficiency. This is a rare opportunity to own a home in one of New Canaan's most desirable locations!
